title: Sub Base
author: SocialGamerz69

scanner.why: crawler_round_ending, end_game name an ending and are this map's own; script hardcodes cost 20000

baseline.note: A name counts as this map's own only if it is absent from WaW's own zone files AND from the boilerplate shared by most maps in the corpus. Built by archive/stock_baseline.py and fed to scan_map.scan(baseline_path=..., ignore=...).

archive.catalogue_description: Hey guys this is one of the first maps that I am actually submitting to ZombieModding! This isn’t the first map i have made and this also isn’t the only map that I have been working on recently so I hope you enjoy! I made this in roughly 3-4 hours and have been tweaking small parts of it for a few weeks. So I guess you can say it was kind of a speed map! Please leave comments on any bugs your find! Features: -Changed FOV -All Perks -Timed Gameplay -REALLY STUPID Easter Egg -Buyable Ending -Broken Dogs (and yes this is a feature :p) *Thank Me Later

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3). PROVISIONAL: archive/corpus-ignore.json was missing, so corpus boilerplate was not subtracted and this finish may be a shared-script name; scan_maps.py --keep-existing rewrites this manifest.
